I submitted the bill for the repair on 20 September 2024 indicating the dossier number [CLAIM]. But until 18 December 2024, I did not receive a reimbursement and, despite several reminders, not even any reply. Hands off Ethias if you want an insurance that gives any response to your queries."

This is about a claim that exists. The customer complains about lack of response and no reimbursement. They mention that they had submitted the bill for repair. They want reimbursement but didn't receive. They are complaining about the handling. They are dissatisfied, asking for escalation? They are complaining about lack of response and no reimbursement. They mention they have reminders but no reply. They are asking for a reimbursement. Is this a complaint? They want reimbursement but also complaining. But we have categories: NEW_CLAIM (new damage not reported before) - not that. CLAIM_FOLLOWUP (email about a claim that already exists: asking for status, sending documents or photos, asking about payment or an expert visit). This email is indeed about a claim that already exists; they are asking for status: "I did not receive a reimbursement." They are complaining. But is this a complaint? The category is about dissatisfaction and asks for escalation or compensation. They do not explicitly ask for escalation, but they say "Hands off Ethias if you want an insurance that gives any response to your queries." It's an angry statement but not a request for a manager or mention of Ombudsman. They are complaining that the insurer didn't respond. According to rule 2: Frustration alone is not a COMPLAINT. A status question written angrily is CLAIM_FOLLOWUP, unless the customer asks for escalation, compensation or mentions Ombudsman / a lawyer.

They are complaining but also not explicitly requesting escalation or manager. They do request reimbursement? They said they haven't received reimbursement. They are basically asking for reimbursement. They are complaining about lack of response. But the rule: if the email is about claim status, we classify as CLAIM_FOLLOWUP.
